name: 18045 · Easton, PA
findings: ZIP 18045 (Easton) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18045 (Easton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
